limitations: This is a task-local proposed prototype, not a production parametric API, approval, or training admission.
Evidence covers only the retained seeds, selected-generator inputs, four declared settings, and declared parameter rivals.
The retain setting makes the source outline visible in the answer; demonstrations must teach this composition explicitly.
The to_axis setting is the existing simple axis-fill rival promoted to an explicit episode-wide rule setting; no claim is made about every possible extent rule.

input_constraints: the selected generator's one-color contiguous row-front manifold
endpoint rows reach the global rightmost source column
all reflected endpoints fit inside the canvas
invariant_reasoning: locate the occupied row span and global rightmost source column
read each interior row's rightmost occupied frontier
paint a right-side fill interval in the source color

fill_extent.reflected: end at the frontier reflected across the global rightmost column
fill_extent.to_axis: end at the global rightmost column

source_policy.retain: start from a copy of the source outline

reflected-clear.text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cells (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0))
                                 (grid-positions g)))
                  (color (at g (fst (fst cells)) (snd (fst cells))))
                  (r0 (min-of fst cells))
                  (r1 (max-of fst cells))
                  (maxc (max-of snd cells)))
             (reduce (lambda (acc r)
                       (let ((rowcells (filter (lambda (p) (= (fst p) r)) cells)))
                         (if (or (empty? rowcells) (= r r0) (= r r1))
                             acc
                             (let* ((rc (max-of snd rowcells))
                                    (end (- (* 2 maxc) rc)))
                               (reduce (lambda (a c)
                                         (if (in-bounds? r c h w)
                                             (set-cell a r c color)
                                             a))
                                       acc
                                       (range (+ rc 1) (+ end 1)))))))
                     (cellmap g (r c v) 0)
                     (range 0 h))))))
